parameters.support_definition: Per resolution: (raw PLA count + raw ChAT count)>0 for each section/bin
parameters.n_meaning: Observed-object-supported physical sections, not tissue coverage
parameters.mean_definition: Equal-section mean PLA count over sections with observed objects in that bin
parameters.missing_definition: Null difference when either condition has zero observed-object-supported sections
parameters.color_scale_policy: Symmetric about zero, identical across arms within each resolution; recomputed for each width
parameters.boundary_convention: Lower numeric edge inclusive; upper exclusive except outer maximum included
parameters.point_detail: All raw PLA objects and exact object IDs/source rows, not sampled display points

limitations: Exploratory bounding-box midpoints are not measured object centroids.
Observed-object support is data-dependent and is not verified tissue coverage, a tissue mask, or a full-bin containment test.
A section with no exported PLA or ChAT in a bin is excluded; tissue with no detected objects may therefore be omitted.
Partial edge bins and holes have unknown coverage; object support can bias condition means and differences.
Counts are unnormalized descriptive section means, with no smoothing, interpolation or inferential tests.
Fixed alignment is preserved; this analysis does not validate anatomical correspondence or physical calibration.
The strict PDF results remain pending existing masks and an applicable centroid definition.

parameters.accumulator_purpose: Exact integer sums from fresh raw objects; no interpolation or support aggregation
parameters.position_definition: Bounding-box midpoint, not measured centroid; unchanged fixed transform
parameters.support_definition: Per resolution: (raw PLA count + raw ChAT count)>0 for each section/bin
parameters.n_meaning: Observed-object-supported physical sections, not tissue coverage
parameters.mean_definition: Equal-section mean PLA count over sections with observed objects in that bin
parameters.missing_definition: Null difference when either condition has zero observed-object-supported sections
parameters.color_scale_policy: Symmetric about zero, identical across arms within each resolution; recomputed for each width
parameters.boundary_convention: Lower numeric edge inclusive; upper exclusive except outer maximum included
parameters.point_detail: All raw PLA objects and exact object IDs/source rows, not sampled display points

limitations: Exploratory bounding-box midpoints are not measured object centroids.
Observed-object support is data-dependent and is not verified tissue coverage, a tissue mask, or a full-bin containment test.
A section with no exported PLA or ChAT in a bin is excluded; tissue with no detected objects may therefore be omitted.
Partial edge bins and holes have unknown coverage; object support can bias condition means and differences.
Counts are unnormalized descriptive section means, with no smoothing, interpolation or inferential tests.
Fixed alignment is preserved; this analysis does not validate anatomical correspondence or physical calibration.
The strict PDF results remain pending existing masks and an applicable centroid definition.

parameters.position_definition: Bounding-box midpoint, not measured centroid; unchanged fixed transform

parameters.n_meaning: Observed-object-supported physical sections, not tissue coverage
parameters.mean_definition: Equal-section mean PLA count over sections with observed objects in that bin
parameters.missing_definition: Null difference when either condition has zero observed-object-supported sections
parameters.color_scale_policy: Symmetric about zero, identical across arms within each resolution; recomputed for each width
parameters.boundary_convention: Lower numeric edge inclusive; upper exclusive except outer maximum included
parameters.point_detail: All raw PLA objects and exact object IDs/source rows, not sampled display points

limitations: Exploratory bounding-box midpoints are not measured object centroids.
Observed-object support is data-dependent and is not verified tissue coverage, a tissue mask, or a full-bin containment test.
A section with no exported PLA or ChAT in a bin is excluded; tissue with no detected objects may therefore be omitted.
Partial edge bins and holes have unknown coverage; object support can bias condition means and differences.
Counts are unnormalized descriptive section means, with no smoothing, interpolation or inferential tests.
Fixed alignment is preserved; this analysis does not validate anatomical correspondence or physical calibration.
The strict PDF results remain pending existing masks and an applicable centroid definition.
